sources.source_ref: RA 386 (1950), Civil Code of the Philippines, Article 1723
sources.document_title: Republic Act No. 386 — Civil Code of the Philippines
verified_sections: Article 1723, paragraph 1 — 15-year liability period from completion of structure
Article 1723, paragraph 1 — Architect/engineer liability for defects in plans, specifications, or ground
Article 1723, paragraph 2 — Solidary liability of contractor and supervising architect for construction defects
Article 1723, paragraph 3 — 10-year prescriptive period from collapse
Article 1723, paragraph 4 — Acceptance of building does not imply waiver of rights
sources.notes: Article 1723 is the foundational liability provision for architects and engineers. Establishes 15-year exposure window, solidary liability, and 10-year prescription period from collapse.

sources.document_title: Republic Act No. 9266 — The Architecture Act of 2004
verified_sections: Section 20(a) — AoR civil liability for plans, specifications, and contract documents
Section 20(b) — AiCC civil liability for construction supervision
sources.notes: Section 20 amplifies the Civil Code liability framework within the professional regulatory context.
